_method: Field-level gold, transcribed by a human reading each image at full resolution. Every numeric value below was read digit by digit from a zoomed crop.
_scope_honesty: This covers 15 of the 47 files, not all of them. All 6 meter readings and 6 of 10 vendor bills carry full field gold. Work reports carry STRUCTURAL gold only - depot, date, entry count and the set of vehicle codes - because verbatim transcription of 25 pages of trilingual handwriting was not achievable in the time available, and a half-accurate gold set is worse than an honestly scoped one. Verbatim work-report gold is the single biggest gap in this evaluation and is called out in DESIGN.md.
_matching: Numbers compare with a small relative tolerance; strings compare case- and punctuation-insensitively; vehicle codes compare on alphanumerics only, so 'GJ-06-AV-4045' and 'GJ 06 AV 4045' agree while '4055' does not.
